Special Containment Procedures: SCP-5459 is to be kept in a 5x5 meter box at all times. No one is to enter the box unless a controlled testing is taking place. 2 armed guards are to be stationed around the box and containment area, rotating every 20 hours. Anyone who is tested, or has been within 20m of SCP-5459 has to undergo a psych brief and debrief, and a day quarantine. SCP-5459 is able to enter others' minds and cause intense emotional distress if in an enraged state. SCP-5459 is agitated and enraged if more than 3 people are in his box. He will stay in normal form if calm, and if enraged may attempt to telepathically confuse others to get himself out or to harm others. Anyone who's mind has been entered by SCP-5459 are to be quarantined for seven (7) days.1 In the event of a containment breach, all personnel are advised to not approach within 20m of SCP-5459 to avoid getting controlled or enraging SCP-5459. If SCP-5459 is needed to be approached, a *maximum* of 2 personnel may approach. Any Class-D attempting to approach SCP-5459 in a containment breach must be terminated.

Description: [IN PROGRESS], summarily deleted at -17 for being an unfinished work, TSATPWTCOTTTADC and Jacob Conwell witnessing via deletion vote.

item.content:encoded:
SCP-5138 was found in a barn in 1979. A farmer looked melted and in 1 pen was SCP-5138. SCP-5138 appears to be a chicken and turkey combined that leaves behind radioactive waste that is similar to the acidity of hydrochloric acid. This radioactive waste is known as SCP-5138-2. SCP-5138-1 instances are eggs laid by SCP-5138. They will taste like anything the consumer is craving and then will fill the consumer with joy. 10 minutes after eating SCP-5138-1 will start to melt you from the inside out. Any living thing breathing SCP-5138-2 will go unconscious and when woken up will instantly go mad. Once 2 minutes pass, the victim will see hallucinations. After 10 minutes, the victim will start wandering around acting like different barn animals. Then finally after 12 minutes the victim will scream in pain then fall to the ground. SCP-5138-1 when hatched immediately grows and becomes an adult. Studies on how this happens are still going on.

Deleted at -20 and three votes.

SCP-5133 is a 1.6m tall bipedal insectoid entity, structured and patterned similarly to a female convergent lady beetle, (Hippodamia convergens) though it only has 4 limbs. Though wings are present in the subject, they are only vestigial.

Deleted at -12 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Quadraginta

+ show block
– hide block

It's a wish-fulfilling humanoid bug person. That in and of itself could have led to something interesting and meaningful if this concept went anywhere with it. Instead, we got an extremely short test log with the only personality being, 'I like to eat larva and I need good sleep.'

While reading this, I got the absolute barebones feeling this thing had the a childlike innocence, but it was so minimal, it didn't matter in the end.

Apologies if this is harsh. -1.

SCP-5232 is a six-sided silver dice of unknown origin (See addendum SCP-5232-1 for more details).SCP-5232 does not manifest any anomalous properties until an entity (humans, animals,or plants) comes within 3m2 of SCP-5232. If an entity comes within the aforementioned area, the dice will proceed to roll itself through unknown means, which tests have shown is completely randomized. (See SCP-5232 testing log for more details.)

Deleted at -12 and three votes. Rewrite by TheAnimateFry pending.

SCP-5667 is an autonomous, whole grain loaf of bread. Upon being damaged, SCP-5667 will regenerate damaged parts using contacting materials. When in contact with solid materials, a grey doughy substance will grow upon SCP-5667 filling and repairing any damaged areas of SCP-5667. This doughy substance will then harden and take on a more bread-like structure. Further analysis of the growth will reveal it to have the same chemical makeup as whatever material SCP-5667 was in physical contact with during the regeneration process. This process has been referred to as “the solid repairment effect” and can take from 30 minutes to 5 hours depending on the solidity of the materials used.

Deleted at -13 and three votes.

item.title: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.: Re: Deletions 70: If the fact will not fit the theory – let the theory go.
item.content:encoded:
/scp-5965 (no title) by CyberKat233 deleted at -25 and three votes.

SCP 5965 is an Apple-II computer that appears brand new even tho it was discovered [REDACTED]

Feedback ported:

[+] from Nipixel_Paxel
– hide block

I see some SPaG (Spelling and Grammar) errors in the article, but I also see formatting errors.
Generally, authors will follow the guide that is linked here. You can also find this article by going onto the sidebar and clicking “How to Write an SCP.”
Anyway onto the criticism of the article itself.
The concept is interesting, however the article is a bit short and there’s no meat to it, if you get what I’m saying. Maybe flesh it out a bit, add something you find interesting about the SCP.

/scp-5188 (no title) by Duccy boi deleted at -26 and three votes.

SCP-5188 is a standard amazon box, with no anomalous effects. SCP-5188's anomalous affects only trigger when touched. When touched, SCP-5188 will suddenly sprout human arms and legs, through the bottom. It looks like a mother████ing cardboard spider. SCP-5188 will then undergo a rage state, where it will kill everything in its path by [DATA EXPUNGED] them.

Feedback ported:

[+] from DrKinyonori
– hide block

First off, I am new to this site, but I still want to give you critique.

Object Class: KETER OH GOSH RUN

Keter means hard to contain, not dangerous. Also, you should not be putting this type of emotion in your writing. Have you ever written an informative essay? Would you put 'THE CHEETAH CAN RUN SUPER FAST DANGER!' in your writing? The answer is no, and it's even more emphasized on this site.

SCP-5188's cell door must be chained by 10 heavy padlocks, have a 5 digit access code, a level 4 card reader, and voice and oral recognition. NOBODY is allowed into SCP-5188's cage UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES (See incident 5188-A-1).

This contradicts itself. You say nobody is allowed in, but it has a level 4 card reader, and an access code. If the former is the current containment procedure, you should strike-through the other part to show it's not valid anymore.

It looks like a mother████ing cardboard spider.

You're writing a research paper, and you decided to put a swear word in your formal report. You need to use plain and professional tone; this is supposed to be a research document on a dangerous object, and you need to write the part.

SCP-5188 is a standard amazon box, with no anomalous effects. SCP-5188's anomalous affects only trigger when touched. When touched, SCP-5188 will suddenly sprout human arms and legs, through the bottom.

There's no narrative to this, and it seems like 'a thing that does a dangerous thing when x happens' cliché. Is there any research into why it does this or how it magically conjures up legs and arms?

SCP-5188 will then undergo a rage state, where it will kill everything in its path by [DATA EXPUNGED] them.

But.. why? I read this and came out feeling bored, because there's no plot or anything; just a dangerous thing which does not have any form of development.

Exactly 69 seconds (1 minute and 9 seconds) after a human is killed, more "cardboard spiders" drag them away.

Wait, how are more cardboard spiders coming out? I thought there was one box which sprouted legs and arms. Also, 69? Really?

therefore they are dubbed SCP-5188-1, and are to be treated as such.

The word choice here is suboptimal. You should say something such as, '(these entities are hereinafter referred to as SCP-5188-1.)'

INCIDENT-5188-A-1:

First off, before the incident, there was a Level 4 padlock. Level 4 clearance is rarely given out to administrative personnel, and even so, why would a Level 4 administrative personnel be in close proximity to a dangerous anomaly?

Dr. ███: THE ████? Is this normal? Ill write this down.

This is not normal human dialogue. A professional researcher wouldn't say this out loud.

Dr. ███: OH ████ ITS WEARING HIS FACE AND ITS ████ING SMILING AT ME! ITS ████ING SMILING! WHAT THE F-

I thought that he would've been prepared for the inevitable, since this was already written in the document before the test (I presume.)

SCP-5188 jumps through the glass and tackles Dr. ███. It then proceeds to
[DATA EXPUNGED]
[REDACTED]
[REDACTED]

Huh? Why are there 3 redactions on 3 different lines? This makes no sense. Redactions =/= mystery value; only if they're done right. There's a good guide to redactions here.

Overall, this is a messy and rushed article, and I'm pretty sure this is a cold post as well. -1.

SCP-5295 is an anomalous fiction storybook that changes it's content every 5-7 days. When SCP-5295 is read by a human the first 3-5 chapters will seem normal compared to an average storybook but all chapters after chapter 5 have been recorded to become darker and more of a horror story. These chapters have been named the "Devil's chapters". When a human begins to read the Devil's chapters their mental state instantly starts to deteriorate. The more that is read, the quicker the deterioration.

They were found in a large pool of liquid, found to be a mix of water with several minerals in, and strange glue like green substance.

/scp-5129 (The Hiker) by Thogri deleted at -17 and three votes.

SCP-5129 is an entity that appears randomly in various parts of the Norwegian wilderness, thought to be its primary hunting grounds. It appears as a humanoid creature roughly 1,8 meters in height and wearing green and black winter clothing, it covers its head with the hood of its jacket and has never been observed without it. Due to SCP-5129 anomalous abilities the only known detail about its face is that it has a warm and friendly smile similar to that of a loved one.

/a-closer-examination-of-scp-173 (A Closer Examination of SCP-173) by Kothardarastrix deleted at -15 and three votes.

Of all the anomalous objects in Foundation custody, there is one that everyone knows. We all read its file when we were in training, and for those of us who trained at Site-19, it was our first up-close and personal encounter with the anomalous. I still remember the first time I saw it; the eye-watering stink of its containment chamber, the blank stare of its fading, sprayed-on face, and, most of all, the sudden understanding that the slightest mistake would send that statue hurtling across the room to wrap its concrete hands around my neck.

Feedback ported:

[+] from Ethagon
– hide block

I like the idea of both the paper itself, the use of cross-testing for actual research, and the "conclusion" it arrives at, but there are a few things that made me downvote:

  • the size of the letters (this is the least important one)
  • Analyzing the documentation of SCP-173. This only makes sense out-of-universe. In-universe it would make more sense to frame this as an analysis of SCP-173's properties itself.
  • I think the writing could still be written a bit more clinical. It also didn't flow very well.
  • The paper makes a hypothesis at multiple points and then proceeds as if the hypothesis was proven fact. It would help a lot if more experimentation was done to support the hypothesis before moving on.
  • It would be better if the two theories at the end, quantum state and extradimensional control, were more aligned with each other. If they were more connected, it would feel more like "everything adds up" instead of a retroactive explanation for SCP-173. The quantum state theory adds a lot to these, as it really "fits" SCP-173 in a way. The extradimensional control theory, not so much.
[+] from The Pighead
– hide block

OK, so for this one, here's short reasons for why I've downvoted.

First of all, I want to be clear that I don't think your article is bad by any means. You've clearly done work about that, the grammar is perfect and the way you write it is pretty good, I've not really seem something that looked non-clinical or something like that.

But there's two reasons of why I downvote. The first one is the fact that, when I've readed some paragraphs, I've thought at least two times "Wait a minute, that looks like a SCPDeclassified post who weirdly tries to take an in-universe approach" and it felt off-topic at times (Wizz talked about the fact that in the article, 173 is a famous thing and it feels weird).

And the second reason is that, even if it's clear that you've done work and research, the paragraphs and the way it's organized looks like big walls of text, to the point that I had struggle reading that because there was too much words and too much scientific things implied, I was a bit lost.

So, that's why I downvote. But I can see a great lot of potential on your Tale, so I highly suggest you to rework it and pay attention to what others suggested you to do.

[+] from Nagiros
– hide block

Frankly I'm unconvinced that we need more 173 content in 2020. I respect the article a fair bit but I'm hardly invested in the character enough for anything resembling this.

Additionally, really not a fan of how the text resizing overadjusts. It's far too large as is.

/scp-5441 (The Water Showed Me Peace…) by Sami Gibbons deleted at -11 after the author blanked the page. Deadly Bread witnessed.

scp-5441 is a body of water like substance of an undetermined size, and an immeasurable depth, many samples of scp-5441 have been collected from inside the containment zone, all results so far have come back as negative to any foreign bodies present in the water, further research is required.

/scp-5212 (The House From Somewhere Else) by Sami Gibbons deleted at -16 after the author blanked the page. Yossipossi witnessed.

SCP-5212 is a late 20th-century house, in the small town of ██████, in Dallas Texas. The building is made of a brick outer wall covering most of the house and tall stone pillars holding up the veranda. The steps to the porch of the house are in disrepair, and the veranda above the porch is in the process of falling apart, with the wood rotting away. The door of the house is to be kept closed until an expedition is permitted.

  • /scp-5212-expedition-1
  • /scp-5212-expedition-2

/scp-5655 (The Charismatic Skull!) by Sami Gibbons deleted at -19 after the author blanked the page. Yossipossi witnessed.

scp-5655 is a sentient human skull made from a substance similar to that of bone. But incredibly more durable than any known earth-based material. Visually scp-5655 is an off creamy colour, with visible cracks, and only 3 teeth missing. Scp-5655 experiences a phenomenon every week on a non-specified day where it completely comes to life and interacts with objects and personnel around it. Scp-5655 claims to be able to see, hear, smell and taste, many tests have taken place to prove this, and all have been proven true.

Deleted an article by GamerboyAli at -3 with zero staff votes, improper-self delete summary deletion.

Description: SCP-5133 appears to be a female of African descent in her early twenties, 150 cm1 tall and 41kg2, with black hair and brown eyes. Anyone that views SCP-5133's face will instinctively think that it is their mother. This anomalous effect will lead the subject to follow every command that is given by SCP-5133. This can include considerably dangerous acts. However, if the subject is deaf, the command that is given will not work3.

No feedback present. Nagiros witnessed.

Footnotes
1. Approximately 4'11".
2. Approximately 90 lbs.
3. However, SCP-5133 will be able to use sign language to communicate with the subject.
